name: @vortex-api/pile
description: Pile SDK + CLI + capture + widget — one package for the whole Pile surface.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && pnpm -C ../capture run build && pnpm -C ../widget run build && mkdir -p dist/capture dist/widget && cp -R ../capture/dist/ dist/capture/ && cp ../widget/dist/chat.iife.js dist/widget/chat.iife.js
scripts.build:bin: bun build --compile --minify src/index.ts --outfile dist/pile && tmpdir=$(mktemp -d) && trap 'rm -rf "$tmpdir"' EXIT && cp dist/pile "$tmpdir/pile" && (cd "$tmpdir" && ./pile tui-check >/dev/null) && echo "build:bin ok — OpenTUI embedded"
